query: I just got back from walking my golden retriever this morning and he rolled in a huge patch of dandelions, so I had to give him a full bath as soon as we got home, and now I'm still covered in dog hair even after changing my shirt. I also just spent 20 minutes trying to figure out why my coffee maker wouldn't turn on, only to realize I forgot to plug it in, so my morning routine is totally thrown off today. I wanted to reach out about my delivered order #W4073673, I need to exchange item 2216662955 for item 9844888101, and please use the saved credit_card_3677959 for any additional payments related to this exchange.
